South Korean retail investors lost $250 million to scams

South Korean retail investors reported losses of approximately $250 million due to fraud in the first half of 2026. This represents a 19.8% increase in the total amount lost compared to the same period last year. The number of reported scam cases rose by 4.1%. Police data indicates that scammers exploited market swings to defraud investors, with 3,506 stock tip-related fraud cases investigated.
